prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-03-05, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-03-05):
| Return 3m            | -9.0% |
| Return 1m            | -3.4% |
| Return 1w            | -4.6% |
| Range position (63d) | 36% |
| 21d realized vol     | 30% |
| Last close           | 260.29 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has shown persistent weakness with -9% over 3 months, -3.4% in 1 month, and -4.6% in the last week, indicating a negative momentum trend. Elevated 21-day realized volatility (30%) and a modest range position (36% over 63 days) suggest risk remains skewed to downside without a clear near-term reversal. With continued negative momentum and risk to the downside, a SELL stance is appropriate for a 20-trading-day horizon.

DECISION: SELL
